summary: This section explains how a company can change the rights attached to a specific group of shares. It requires written consent from a large majority of those shareholders or a special vote at their separate meeting. It also allows minority shareholders who disagree to ask the Tribunal to cancel the change under certain conditions.
points: Allows changing rights of a share class with written consent of at least three-fourths of that class.
Allows changing rights through a special resolution passed at a separate meeting of that share class.
Requires the company memorandum, articles, or terms of issue to allow or not prohibit the variation.
Requires consent from three-fourths of any other class of shareholders whose rights are also affected.
Permits holders of at least ten per cent of the class shares who did not agree to apply to the Tribunal to cancel the change.
Requires the company to file a copy of the Tribunal order with the Registrar within thirty days.
example: Meera Textiles Private Limited has two different classes of shares. The company wants to change the voting rights attached to the Class A shares. To do this legally, the company obtains the written consent of the holders of at least three-fourths of the issued Class A shares. Alternatively, they pass a special resolution at a separate meeting of Class A shareholders. Because this change also affects the rights of the Class B shareholders, the company must also obtain the consent of three-fourths of the Class B shareholders. A group holding twelve percent of Class A shares disagrees and applies to the Tribunal within twenty-one days to cancel the variation, so the change waits for Tribunal confirmation.

terms.meaning: A formal decision passed by a high majority of votes as required by the law.
The foundational document that sets out the constitution of a company.
The document containing the internal rules and regulations for managing the company.
A judicial body appointed to handle company law disputes.

watch: Make sure to check if other classes of shareholders are affected, as their consent is also needed.
